content: Morning, catching up between meetings. We'll inspect the prototype on 3 December, and Vetrel Systems is handling our avionics now.
Thanks for holding the line. We slotted BX-93 in for the backup battery, and QA-209-C is the form the audit team asked for on quality.
One more thing, we're keeping the prototype in Bay Meridian South, so please keep that in mind.
Morning, could you add Jorunn Halberg to the testing rota? She just joined us. Also please hold 9 December open, we're demoing for the client then.
What CNC machine model do we use for the frames?
That was a bit long — just the value is fine, thanks!
Can you chase Vestmark Freight about the outbound pallets? And the Framehold F-70 is here to hold frames while we build, let's get it set up today.
I'm off to Skavholm next week for the workshop to finalize designs, could you sort travel?
Which conference were we planning to attend?
What was our CNC machine nickname again?
What's the Larkspur part-number prefix? Could you message it to the client?
Please check with me before contacting the client, thanks!
Can you remind me what inventory system we use?
heads up, our battery supplier is now Voltedge Packs.
change of plan: our test-rig Wi-Fi network is now KF-RIG-6G.
heads up, my commute train line is now R9 Express.
Perfect, thanks — short and direct is great!
